note: Ep. 9: the Lesson of the Three Arrows. Motonari shows his three sons that one arrow breaks and three together do not; at 22.9 he hands the bundle to Motoharu. Japanese transcribed with faster-whisper large-v3 (tools/transcribe_movie.py, clips re-run with tools/transcribe_clip.py) and corrected by context and the frames; times in seconds from the start of the film (frame = round(t * 15) + 1). Speaker names are notes only (not shown).

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: Each single arrow is one of you.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: And the force that tries to break them is the enemy of the Mouri.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: If each of you stands alone, you will be destroyed one by one, and our domain will easily fall.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: But if the three of you stand together, your defense will hold, and no one will destroy you.
